Hi Linda — apologies for the slight delay, and thanks for sending the questionnaire — Vivek and Rishi helped compile the answers below and I attached the SOC 2 report and a labeled EU-region diagram. Summary:

1) SOC 2
- Attached: RH_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (redacted distribution copy). Scope: Redwood Inference hosting (ingestion, model runtime, logging) — Type II report covering period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Let me know if you need an NDA'd/back-channel copy for legal review.

2) EU data residency
- We offer dedicated production tenancy in eu-west-1 (Ireland) and eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). Customers can request their tenancy and storage be pinned to EU regions (no routing to US control plane for customer data). See attached EU_Data_Residency_Diagram.png for topology.

3) Cross-border transfers & export controls
- Backups & data-at-rest: by default encrypted and stored in the elected region. We do not transfer customer data out of the elected region for routine operations.
- Legal controls: we execute a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) with SCCs for EU transfers where applicable. We can support additional contractual clauses on request.
- OFAC/ITAR: Redwood does not accept ITAR-controlled datasets for processing on our hosted platform. For OFAC, we comply with sanctions screening and will refuse service to denied parties; we can implement customer-level blocks if required.

4) HIPAA / BAA
- Redwood supports PHI workloads and will execute a BAA for customers that require it. Our legal team typically takes 1–2 weeks for standard BAAs; we can prioritize Acme.

Next steps:
- Attached: RH_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (stub) and EU_Data_Residency_Diagram.png (stub).
- Vivek (cc) will be your primary technical contact for the questionnaire — he can set up a follow-up call with your security team to walk through answers and any evidence requests.
- If you'd like a live demo of isolated EU tenancy, we can spin a short POC environment within 3–5 business days once we have internal approvals.

Let me know if you want the SOC 2 delivered under NDA or if you prefer our public redacted copy for now. Happy to coordinate the BAA and the security call.
